Chapter 940: Chapter 6: An Opportunity Falls From The Sky (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 940: Chapter 6: An Opportunity Falls from the Sky (Please Subscribe)

“Can I take away the treasures from the Human Civilization Treasury?”

Lin Yuan couldn’t help but hold his breath.

‘Take away’, as mentioned by the Xuanyuan Supreme, probably does not require any merit points.

It means he can take them as needed.

One must know that human civilization is the peak of all races.

The treasury of human civilization has recorded many Twelve-Star rare treasures.

“Yes, as long as you find it necessary, you can directly transfer them,” nodded the Xuanyuan Supreme.

“Thank you, Supreme,” said Lin Yuan.

Although most treasures in the human civilization’s treasury are of little use to Lin Yuan.

The resources to cultivate the ‘Body of Xuanhuang’ to Level Eleven Perfect? Even if he drained all the resources of the entire universe, it would still be far from enough; the entire treasure trove of human civilization is nothing but a drop in the bucket to him.

But the Xuanyuan Supreme is unaware of this.

Since Xuanyuan Supreme has said so, he must be prepared for a significant shrinkage in the rare treasures of the human civilization’s treasury.

“As long as you can successfully enter the Twelve-Star level, whatever the cost to our human civilization, it will be worth it,” said the Xuanyuan Supreme.

“I’m planning on making my ultimate breakthrough after some time,” Lin Yuan nodded, feeling the expectation that Xuanyuan Supreme had for him.

“Before making the ultimate breakthrough, remember to use the few protective treasures in the treasury,” reminded the Xuanyuan Supreme.

In the treasury of human civilization, there exist some treasures that aid in making the ultimate breakthrough, like the Source of the Universe previously obtained by Lin Yuan, which can increase the timeline foundation of the world within his body.

There are also other treasures similar to the Source of the Universe that those Eleven-Star Perfect Ancient Gods in the depths of cosmic starry skies desire immensely.

Previously, the Tuoba Ancient God would rather offend Lin Yuan, an exceptional talent of human civilization, in the hopes of extorting one such rare treasure.

“Understood,” Lin Yuan nodded.

After being promoted to Level Eleven Citizen, Lin Yuan’s personal authority reached the highest in human civilization, enabling him to view any treasure information.

“Also, when you’re ready for the ultimate breakthrough, make sure to tell us so we can guard against those alien Twelve-Star beings,” the Xuanyuan Supreme said.

The transition from Level Eleven to Twelve-Star, after the ultimate leap, means that one’s life essence and everything about oneself step out of the river of time and can’t be interfered with or affected, even by the Supreme.

However, before that, enduring the infusion of the Chaos Void Origin, if the Twelve-Star ultimate discovery is made in time, it’s still possible to have an influence on it.

Of course, it’s only a possibility.

But Lin Yuan is crucial to human civilization, so naturally, the Xuanyuan Supreme wants to eliminate all possibilities.

“Sure.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

When advancing to the Tenth and Eleventh levels, there were Supremes protecting him; it will be no different when attempting to reach the Twelve-Star level.

“Then continue your cultivation, and if you have any requests, just speak to me or Xia Qin,” said the Xuanyuan Supreme before ending the video call.

…

“The ultimate breakthrough?”

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, beginning to browse through the many treasures in the Human Civilization Treasury.

Ordinary rare treasures, even those of the Twelve-Star level, had little effect on Lin Yuan.

Lin Yuan mainly focused on the treasures mentioned by the Xuanyuan Supreme that aid in the ultimate breakthrough.

“These rare treasures…”

Lin Yuan glanced over them and shook his head slightly.

The rare treasures in the human civilization that aid in the ultimate breakthrough would surely be a godsend to any ordinary Eleven-Star Perfect powerhouse.

But to Lin Yuan, they had almost no effect.

The support treasures for the ultimate breakthrough also come in different grades, with the Heart of Space-Time left by the Moyu Tower Master being of the highest grade, while others like the Source of the Universe are of medium grade.

The normal probability for an Eleven-Star being to make the ultimate breakthrough ranges from one in ten thousand to one in a million.

In such cases, even the lowest grade of ultimate breakthrough aiding treasures can have a substantial impact.

But Lin Yuan? His chances of making the ultimate breakthrough might probably be as high as ninety-five or even ninety-seven to ninety-eight percent.

With Lin Yuan’s accumulated foundation, even the highest grade support treasures like the Heart of Space-Time would have limited effect on him, and the other auxiliary treasures in the treasury would not be much help at all.

It’s not hard to go from one in ten thousand to two in ten thousand, but going from ninety-eight percent to ninety-nine is as hard as ascending to the heavens.

In fact, even among those Eleven-Star beings in the Chaos Void with immense backgrounds, the probability of making an ultimate breakthrough does not exceed twenty percent.

Lin Yuan’s ability to reach ninety-five percent is solely due to his understanding of the Chaos Rule and the Seventh Realm of space-time, among other factors.

“Let these auxiliary rare treasures be left for the later evolutionaries attempting the Twelve-Star breakthrough,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

…

Virtual World.

Lin Yuan was having a casual chat with his parents and his sister Lin Yi.

“Brother, have you heard? The Martial Tao evolutionary pathway is now ranked fifth among the human civilization’s evolutionary pathways? The origin planet of the Martial Tao lineage is even Canglan Star…” Lin Yi said excitedly.

The hottest topic in human civilization currently is definitely the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway. Merely an Eleven-Star evolutionary pathway and yet it ranks fifth among humans, surpassing the four great Supreme pathways?

Even the most ordinary citizens are aware of what this means.

Lin Yi felt the same way. Initially, Lin Yuan had asked her if she wanted to pursue the path of Martial Tao evolution, but Lin Yi didn’t like the evolutionary pathways that required close-quarter combat and eventually chose the remote attack pathway of psychic evolution.

As it turned out, Lin Yi’s judgment was not quite up to par.

Lin Yuan smiled.

“Not only did Canglan Star produce a peerless evolutionary genius like me, but it also has the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway, tsk tsk…”

Lin Yi spoke with a tone of surprise, finding it too much of a coincidence.

“It is somewhat coincidental.”

Lin Yuan smiled faintly.

In his heart, he had already predicted that some might connect him with the founder of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway.

Under normal circumstances, as a peerless evolutionary genius, Lin Yuan became a Level Eleven evolver in less than a millennium, an invincible Level Eleven who overwhelmed and crushed the peak powers of other factions.

That identity just did not match with that of a pathway founder.

The creation of an evolutionary pathway requires a vast expenditure of time and effort. Merely being an unmatched Level Eleven evolver in less than a millennium is extraordinary enough, but the identity of the founder of the Martial Tao pathway?

Even though both originated from Canglan Star, initially no one connected the two.

But as time passed, with the Martial Tao pathway improving its rank and Lin Yuan’s continuous promotion, within human civilization, evolutionists began to associate Lin Yuan with the founder of Martial Tao.

Now that the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway has become the fifth pathway of human civilization, coupled with Lin Yuan’s performances in the super-large-scale battlefields.

Even without inquiring, Lin Yuan knew that the rumors linking him and the founder of Martial Tao were growing.

However, Lin Yuan wasn’t too concerned about this.

At his current level, even if he were to reveal his identity as the founder of Martial Tao, so what? With strength not inferior to that of the normal Path Splitting Realm, he could hardly die within this universe.

“Brother, what are you looking at?”

Seeing Lin Yuan gazing into the distance, Lin Yi couldn’t help but ask curiously.

“Looking at what?” Lin Yuan smiled faintly. “I’m looking at what lies beyond the universe.”

“Beyond the universe?” Lin Yi blinked. Up till now, there were many areas within the human civilization territory that she didn’t even know about, let alone beyond the universe.

…

Beyond the universe.

Chaos Void.

Lin Yuan, with an avatar condensed from Chaos Qi, slowed to a halt.

“I have finally escaped the influence of the universe.” Lin Yuan looked back, and at this moment, his home universe had shrunk to the size of a fist. Unknowingly, Lin Yuan had already left his home universe far behind.

Even within the Chaos Void, universes are vast celestial bodies, and each universe influences a large surrounding area.

And now, Lin Yuan felt completely free from the influence of the Main Universe.

“Hmm?”

“The flow rate of time has changed.”

Lin Yuan concentrated on his senses, comparing with his true self’s Primordial Spirit. The place he was in now had a slower flow of time, roughly at a ratio of one to three hundred in comparison with the time flow inside the universe.

In other words.

Three hundred years pass in the Main Universe, and only one year goes by in the Chaos Void.

“The flow of time… The time flow rate in the Chaos Void is similar to that in that Origin World.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. After reaching the Seventh Realm, thirty-three world coordinates appeared within the depths of the Myriad Realms Gate, each of them connecting to vast and expansive Origin Worlds.

The first Origin World explored by Lin Yuan had a time flow rate ratio of one to three hundred compared to the Main Universe.

“Could the Chaos Void and that Origin World be on the same level?” Through the time flow rate ratio, Lin Yuan could make some deductions.

Of course, these are just conclusions and not necessarily the truth. The time flow rate can only reflect the relative height of the world’s level to a certain extent and is not absolute.

“Continue exploring then.”

Lin Yuan chose a direction and vanished, appearing millions of light-years away in an instant.

Chaos Void is boundless and immense. Even with millions of light-years traversed, the scenery around Lin Yuan had not changed, and likewise, no change was visible in the Main Universe behind him.

“The rules of the Chaos Void are more complete; the pressure to mobilize these rules will be greater.” As he explored, Lin Yuan carefully perceived.

If the many rules of the Main Universe are like an iron rod, then the rules of the Chaos Void are comparable to a heavenly pillar.

Swinging an iron rod as opposed to a heavenly pillar naturally presents a chasm of difficulty.

Therefore, in the Chaos Void, the destructive power of the strong ones from the Main Universe would greatly diminish.

Of course, the more complete and vast Chaos Void provides a higher ceiling for any strong being. At least within the Chaos Void, stepping into the dominion realm is somewhat easier than within the confines of the universe.

Whoosh whoosh whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s form continuously disappeared and reappeared, crossing great distances; the Chaos Rules outside of the Seventh Realm of Space-Time allowed him to move through the Chaos Void with ease.

Boom boom boom.

Suddenly, Lin Yuan halted, turning his gaze towards a certain direction.

A ‘shooting star’ was rapidly falling from above, predicted to pass by Lin Yuan’s current location.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan observed the ‘shooting star’, “There are fluctuations of an item’s aura. Does it contain many twelve-star rare treasures?”

“Could my luck really be this good?” Lin Yuan quietly mused.

Just casually sending out an avatar for exploration and encountering a chance event of treasures falling from the sky?
